item.title: A screenwriter claims her idea for what became the TV series 'Yellowstone' was stolen
item.description: A screenwriter is suing a major Hollywood television producer, alleging that her screenplay and ideas were stolen and used in the hit TV series Yellowstone.
item.content:encoded: A screenwriter is suing a major Hollywood television producer, alleging that her screenplay and ideas were stolen and used in the hit TV series Yellowstone.

item.title: The UN passed resolution ahead of General Assembly calling for end to child marriage
item.description: The UN estimates 650 million women and girls currently alive were married before age 18. A new resolution aims to bring awareness and push countries to act to end child marriage.
item.content:encoded: The UN estimates 650 million women and girls currently alive were married before age 18. A new resolution aims to bring awareness and push countries to act to end child marriage.

item.title: Countertop workers with silicosis struggle to get benefits meant to help them
item.description: Many California countertop workers diagnosed with silicosis from engineered stone are struggling to obtain workers' compensation benefits as insurers deny claims.

item.title: The far-right AfD's victory in eastern Germany has sent a political signal to Berlin
item.description: A landslide victory for the far-right AfD in a tiny German region sends seismic political tremors far beyond its borders.

item.title: Federal aviation investigators look into deadly Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami
item.description: Federal aviation investigators are searching for answers following a deadly cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport Sunday that killed five people and injured at least five others.

item.title: The copper peptide trend has gone from creams to injections — ahead of the science
item.description: Copper peptides are among the biggest viral trends on social media. Does evidence support smearing on the electric blue tincture for firmer skin, wound healing and other anti-aging effects?

item.title: Union electricians welcome data center boom
item.description: The boom in data centers has brought plenty of work and lots of overtime to union electricians, putting them at odds with many communities trying to block new data center construction.

item.title: How a birthday trip to Africa — and the work of Octavia Butler — led to a picture book
item.description: A 50th birthday trip to Ghana and Senegal sparked a new picture book called That You Are Here is No Small Thing, which guides children through Black American history.

item.title: One TPS recipient shares what it's like to live under uncertainty
item.description: With Temporary Protection Status expected to expire next week for Salvadorans, TPS recipient Daysi Gonzales has been documenting her life in limbo on social media.
